definitions.name: Stale opportunities (Fastening Specialists)
definitions.sql: SELECT deal_id, title AS opportunity, owner_name AS owner, stage_name AS stage, days_stale FROM pipedrive_stale_deals_view WHERE entity = 'fs' AND (days_since_activity >= 7 OR days_in_stage >= 14)

_notes: Template only. Per scoreboard's kpi-spec rule lock: stale = no qualifying activity in 7 days OR same stage 14+ days.
certified stays false until the SQL is validated against company-brain's real schema and the evidence is recorded in scoreboard's tractionos-promotion-evidence-ledger (or successor).
The scanner refuses uncertified definitions unless KPI_EXCEPTIONS_ALLOW_UNCERTIFIED=true (development only).
